summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a sermon on divine providence and planning, using the story of Thumamah ibn Uthal as a central example. Thumamah was a leader of Banu Hanifah who initially opposed the Prophet Muhammad and attempted to assassinate him, but was captured and brought to Medina. After three days tied to a pillar in the masjid, listening to the Quran and witnessing the faith of the Muslims, Thumamah embraced Islam. Sh. Ali Mashhour emphasizes how Allah's plan operates through seemingly random events, and how the Prophet's mercy toward his enemies resulted in Thumamah becoming a powerful ally who later controlled the grain trade and prevented Quraysh from receiving supplies unless the Prophet permitted it.
suggested_title: The Story of Thumamah: From Enemy to Believer - A Lesson in Divine Providence
